members.name: vwap_zscore_bounce_v1
members.thesis: Normalizing price deviation from VWAP into a z-score using rolling standard deviation creates a statistically grounded entry signal. When z-score of (price - VWAP) falls below -2.0 or rises above +2.0, the deviation is >2 sigma from the session mean — a statistically rare event that tends to snap ba
members.exit_stop: entry_price - 1.2 * ATR(14) for longs; entry_price + 1.2 * ATR(14) for shorts
filters: India_VIX < 24; reduce size 50% if VIX between 20-24
no entries after 14:30 IST; need at least 30 min of data (after 09:45)
none — strategy is counter-trend by design
weaknesses: Z-score calculation requires 30+ bars of data, so no trades in first 30 min when volatility is highest
In trending markets, z-score can remain extreme for extended periods — strategy gets stopped out repeatedly
Rolling std denominator is unstable early in session; z-score can give false signals with low sample size

members.name: zscore_reversion_v1
members.thesis: Pure statistical z-score reversion using a 60-bar lookback (1 hour of 1-min data) identifies when price has deviated >2.0 standard deviations from its rolling 60-bar mean. Unlike VWAP z-score (strategy 2), this uses raw price z-score which captures deviations from the recent trading range rather tha
members.exit_stop: zscore reaches -3.0 (longs) or +3.0 (shorts) — 3-sigma extreme, thesis broken
filters: India_VIX < 25; in high-vol regimes, z-score extremes are more common but less mean-reverting
no entries before 10:00 (need 60 bars of data) or after 14:30
skip if rolling_mean slope > 0.1% per bar (strong intraday trend — z-score will stay extreme)
weaknesses: 60-bar lookback means signal only available after 10:15 IST — misses the most volatile (and potentially profitable) first hour
Assumes returns are approximately normally distributed; intraday returns have fat tails, making z-score thresholds unreliable
Hurst exponent filter requires significant computation and changes over time — stocks can switch from mean-reverting to trending
